temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hospital hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying he appreciates the concern but has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated and hardworking friend and doctor, but he has become increasingly concerned that Gary may be pushing himself too hard.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital workload is a serious obstacle and that he is not yet willing or able to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and at risk of harming his health, and that Gary's sense of obligation to the hospital is preventing him from accepting help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat frustrated or helpless.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and help Gary relax or reconsider his workload, perhaps by finding another way to support him or persuade him to take a break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits things are complicated and says he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and that hospital obligations are the main issue, though he may also sense Gary is reluctant to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restless behavior and comment about not wanting to burden Ethan lead Ethan to suspect deeper personal or emotional problems beyond professional workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes there is more to Gary's overworking than just hospital demands, and that Gary is carrying hidden pressures he has been afraid to share.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and encourage him to open up, while reassuring him that he is not a burden and will not be judged.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Ethan responds by suggesting they prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities; Gary agrees he could use help organizing his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is hiding deeper problems beyond ordinary hospital workload, and that Gary needs support to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The specifics of Gary's new department pressures and personal challenges clarify the causes of his overwork, replacing Ethan's vague suspicion with a clearer understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is driven by identifiable professional and personal stressors, and that Gary can improve his balance if he prioritizes tasks and delegates.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly with Gary and discusses Gary's progress and remaining challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and says he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is capable of improving with support, but still faces challenges and needs encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reported progress and leisure time confirm that the plan is working and that Gary is making genuine efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is on a healthier trajectory and is becoming less overwhelmed, though continued support is still helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support and encouragement, and reinforcing Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and is managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and becoming less overwhelmed, but may still benefit from regular support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control show that he no longer needs active intervention from Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of managing his own work-life balance and that he can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but let Gary know he is always available if needed.
